raw.hs_code: 9302.00 / 9303.30 / 9305.20 (civilian firearms, sporting shotguns/rifles, parts) — verify current HTS line
raw.source: US BIS — Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and control treatment for civilian firearms, sporting shotguns/rifles and related parts. For China-origin or China-routed shipments to the US market, exporters should re-baseline classification under the restored EAR framework, confirm the item is not a defense article under ITAR/USML, and re-check HTS alignment and Section 301 exposure. Screen all parties against BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List and OFAC SDN, and retain end-use/end-user documentation. Note that easing of US export controls does not relax China export licensing or US import requirements (ATF/FFL, marking, FCC where electronics are involved).
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销拜登时期的枪支出口规则，放宽民用枪支、运动用霰弹枪/步枪及零部件的许可与管制待遇。对输美或经第三国转运至美国的中国原产货物，出口商应按恢复后的EAR框架重新确定分类，确认物项不属于ITAR/USML军品，并复核HTS归类与301关税风险。须对BIS实体清单、拒绝人员名单及OFAC SDN进行筛查，并留存最终用途/最终用户证明。注意：美方管制放松并不免除中国出口许可义务及美国进口要求（ATF/FFL、标识、涉及电子部件的FCC认证）。

checklist.desc: Re-determine ECCN/ECCN-NLR status under the restored EAR firearms framework; confirm the item is not an ITAR/USML defense article and document the classification rationale.
Align the 10-digit HTS line (9302/9303/9305 family) with Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin and value build-up.
For any electronic sights, optics or RF components, confirm FCC Part 15/18 conformity and supplier FCC IDs before US entry.
Screen all parties against BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List and OFAC SDN; retain end-user and end-use statements.
Verify ATF/FFL importer status, marking requirements and commercial invoice/packing list consistency with the declared HTS line.
Check lead/ammunition-component and surface-finish restrictions; confirm RoHS-equivalent and hazardous materials declarations where applicable.
